2. Gather 3 more glowstones dust to make 3 more glowstones.
3. Use these 3 glowstones to make 2 arrows using 3 glowstone dusts each.
4. Use the remaining glowstone dust to make the fourth glowstone.
5. Combine all 4 glowstone dusts to make 1 glowstone.
